hardware_authority.uart: USART6 PA11 TX / PA12 RX, 3.3 V TTL, protocol 0x0001
hardware_authority.hal_driver_observation: Vendored stm32f4xx_hal_uart.c was inspected: the USART IRQ records UART error flags before UART_Receive_IT can invoke RxEventCallback; this callback checks ErrorCode before rearming, because rearm resets ErrorCode. The host test invokes RxEvent then ErrorCallback and verifies no rearm on the earlier error. No MCU execution was performed.
